experiment: Experiment 1: AAPM TG-43U1 HDR 192Ir Dosimetric Impact & Uncertainty-to-Dose Propagation (54 Clinical GYN Patients)

contour_and_plan_provenance_check.target_and_oar_definition: Standardized 1.5 mm isotropic 3D evaluation grid per patient with implant-conformal HR-CTV_implant (8.0 mm radial envelope around reference active dwells, D90 normalized to 100% = 7.0 Gy via damped NNLS/HIPO) and anatomical OAR 2cc proxy shells: Bladder_proxy (anterior 5.5-16 mm), Rectum_proxy (posterior 5.5-16 mm), and Sigmoid/Bowel_proxy (cranial cap 3.5-15 mm superior to catheter tips).
